_comment: The pool a FACTION's name is drawn from - the name a people calls itself, the kind of name that takes 'the' in speech (the Veldari, the Ashkin). CONTENT, not tuning. STYLE: every entry is ONE invented collective noun in a stone-age or early-agrarian register - a people's name for its own kind, not a place - so it reads distinct from the band pool (core_sim/src/data/band_names.json), whose entries are compounds of the land a band lives on (Alderfen, Brackwater). No entry holds a digit or a space, so a roman-numeral cycle suffix can never collide with a bare name. Order is load-bearing only as an index space: the world shuffles it ONCE from the map seed (map_seed ^ FACTION_NAME_SALT) and faction N takes position N, so two factions of one world can never share a name. Editing this list changes which name a faction resolves to in a NEW world; a saved game keeps its names, because the save carries them (FactionNames rides SimState). Entries must be DISTINCT - the loader refuses a duplicate rather than silently deduplicating it. See core_sim/src/faction_names.rs.
